name: Admin Panel Projects Module
description: The Plataforma space in the panel sidebar opens /panel/projects: the commercial face of accounts.Project, the entity hostings, incomes and cuentas de cobro reference. The listing loads once and filters client-side by the active, user-managed lifecycle catalog. At expanded widths, non-zero lifecycle and operational cards use the same four/five-column grid and 72–80px horizontal layout: identity stays left, count/action stays right and contextual help occupies a contained 48px column. Operational support copy remains one bounded line without changing card dimensions. Opening help never activates the card. At 412px and 835px the header remains exactly two actionable summaries whose contained help and drawers retain all lifecycle states, including zeroes, and every operational detail; the first project remains visible in the initial phone viewport. Activating a lifecycle indicator filters the list, while operational indicators open their corresponding workflow. Search remains accent/case-blind over project and client, sortable columns show name/client/state/created plus per-project hosting and income counts that — for superusers — link into the accounting tabs pre-filtered via ?project=<id>. The Clientes sin proyecto action opens a create path pre-seeded with that client. Create presents name, client, initial state and description as one full-width block; En desarrollo is visibly selected, so no contradictory default-state help is shown. Required-field errors appear under name and client after a save attempt, while the action row contains only Cancelar and Guardar. Client creation remains visible inside the picker even when search matches exist. Later lifecycle changes are excluded from edit and belong to the previewed transition flow. A same-name project warns without blocking. At 412px and 835px state filtering is a selector, sorting stays explicit and the listing becomes one/two-column cards; from 1195px the table returns. Create, edit, orphan assignment, client change and lifecycle dialogs are full-screen on phones, with sticky actions; the page is capped at 1400px on wide monitors. Las acciones ahora se agrupan en la primera columna sin título visible, mediante tres puntos; las tarjetas comparten el mismo menú. Eliminar sólo borra proyectos vacíos tras confirmar y muestra dependencias y cantidades cuando hay información que conservar.
